model.name: iOS-shaped upload correctness — content-type boundary parameter handling (quoted boundary + charset params)
model.description: #126 BACKFILL, named as such: the single most critical fix this week — the iOS-shaped upload outage fix — shipped CHAIN-LESS because it arose as a Tron priority-override during a live outage instead of scenario-first, so it has NO covering requirement/task and the permanent gate r4090 (c9c6acb8a) is referenced by NO Test/Impl. THE REQUIREMENT: iOS-shaped upload correctness = content-type BOUNDARY parameter handling (a QUOTED boundary + trailing ;charset params) so a native-file upload parses on EVERY client. Root of the outage: content-type.split('boundary=') kept the iOS QUOTED boundary -> 0 parts -> 401/419. Re-point to BUILT REALITY (R30.11 pattern, NOT design-ahead): the shipped fix = server.ts boundary extraction, v0.8.190, commit 7cc4717fb (surgical dequote, body byte-unchanged). We close the rule-break rather than argue it.
